scope: Only frozen b735 configuration hardlink reader and event/session protocol; old616 approval is not reused as this signature.

staticConclusions.fact: The reader always resolves fixed workerDevVarsSource; ancestors are non-symlink and physically equal both before and after read. Regular file, positive nlink,16MiB limit and raw length retained. dev/ino/nlink/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs are compared before/after and recorded as immutable baseline fields; only atime is omitted.

Only path.resolve case-normalized equality with fixed runtime source selects this reader. Alias/other path falls back to generic safeRead single-link. Ordinary source/npmrc/evidence contracts and full artifact source/release/Worker hardlink identity proof are not changed.
Fixed configuration baseline is captured synchronously before first watcher installation and before full identify. It is not replaced by later observed bytes or TTL/refill.
Only fixed file exact basename, event change, non-source/nonrecursive watch marks configurationPending. Source/npm/rename/null/unknown and watcher errors keep irreversible changed invalidation.

assertStable refuses changed/disposed, synchronously re-reads all bytes/path/identity for pending and compares original baseline before clearing it. Drift sets changed and throws; a late notification after hash or collection is revalidated at the next boundary, not ignored.

Every observe independently compares fixed runtime read with baseline, keeps complete source bracket/Node/npm/environment/config comparisons, then assertsStable after yielding. Full/reuse/recheck, lifetime10min, maximum24 uses and exclusive failure entry clearing remain.

cases: Baseline-before-registration and matching configuration notification causes a real private synchronous re-read; full/reuse/recheck remain usable.
Injected late notification after runtime hash/source-final and after collect return remains pending; changed bytes then reject and cannot clear changed on later assertStable.
Same bytes/same nlink/new real inode rejects against original immutable baseline.
Source/npm/null-unknown/fixed rename events reject and remain invalidated.
One genuine OS fs.watch private Windows configuration change event was observed; rewriting identical bytes changes identity timestamps and is rejected.
Other same-inode hardlink path and external npmrc hardlink retain strict rejection.
With no watcher event, Node/source/npm/environment drift individually invalidates reused input snapshots.
independentTests.seams: Exact source evaluated in VM, actual Windows private file/link/stat/read/rename and one actual private fs.watch case. Other watch callbacks are explicitly injected; source inventory/full identity/npm transport are private fixtures. No observeInputs override or product module import. No formal config/npm values read.
independentTests.syntaxChecks: Frozen helper and independent test node --check exit0.

limitations: A private injected metadata-only notification is a model of a fixed-file change event, not proof that actual Windows notifications came from atime, another task or AV.
The genuine private watcher case proves only that a real notification with unchanged bytes but changed protected timestamps is rejected; it does not prove production access-event causality.
Original held-input-change/ordinary source/unknown notifications remain fail-closed and unresolved unless separately proved. No old failure is rewritten as success.
No actual production configuration/NPM/watch probe/collector/CLI, source fix or native lifecycle call was performed.
New complete source/artifact/helper/collector/batch byte binding and actual native in-process session require later separate verification. Old aed7/872d/616 signatures cannot be reused.
